verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia component ships narrow embedded AI features (AI-generated mock servers from prompts, AI commit-message suggestions, local-model support) that let a user delegate specific sub-tasks to built-in AI, but there is no general-purpose 'AI assistant' within Kong Gateway or Konnect itself that a user can converse with or delegate arbitrary tasks to — the AI Gateway/MCP capabilities are infrastructure for routing/governing external AI traffic, not an assistant.  Missing for 10: a documented conversational/task-delegation assistant inside Kong Gateway/Konnect, evidence of multi-step task handling (not just single-shot generation), and independent corroboration of these AI features working reliably.
